# Apply Fixes

## Change Summary

No additional fixes were applied in this round because the latest review approved the implementation and provided no follow-up amendments.

## Steps

1. [Completed] Confirmed the latest review outcome was approved and that the follow-up amendment list was empty.
2. [Skipped] Skipped code edits because there were no requested fixes to apply in this round.
3. [Completed] Recorded the no-op outcome and carried forward the latest relevant validation evidence from the prior stages.

## Validation Evidence

- Review payload `run-20260328125529-review-c2-a1-cr3` reported `outcome: approved` with an empty `follow_up_or_amendments` list.
- Latest existing verification from prior stages remains: `cargo test -p tank_api` passed (3 tests).

- Latest existing verification from prior stages remains: `cargo test -p tank_tui --lib` passed (7 tests), `cargo check -p tank_tui` passed, and `cargo clippy -p tank_api -p tank_tui -p tank_core -- -D warnings` was clean.

## Outstanding Risks

- The worktree may still contain unrelated pre-existing modifications noted in prior stages; this no-op apply-fixes pass did not touch them.
- No new validation commands were run in this round because no code changed; the latest verification remains the targeted test, check, and clippy results recorded in the prior implementation and review stages.
- There is still a minor coverage gap around exact end-to-end TUI render text assertions, but the review accepted the current targeted overview/chemistry coverage.
